method.initialRun: 64 public/synthetic clips through the production native adapter with all network denied, before App installation.
method.observedRegression: The inherited absolute RMS/peak activity threshold silently discarded 15 quiet public-human speech clips. The failed initial results remain unchanged externally.
method.correction: Only all-zero digital silence is skipped. Nonzero audio, at its original amplitude and with full bounded context, reaches the ASR model.
method.affectedRerun: Only the 15 previously discarded clips plus the two non-speech controls were rerun with network denied. The other 47 already exercised the unchanged decode/alignment branch; no passing corpus inference was repeated.
method.aggregation: Quality counts combine the 47 unchanged initial outputs with the 17 explicit replacement outputs by exact sample UUID, source path and reference. This is a composite regression result, not a second full timing run.
method.scoring: Same repository TranscriptScorer and identical supplementary NFC/lowercase/alphanumeric content CER as the earlier comparison. No thresholds or accepted date surfaces were rewritten.

checks.realNativeCancellationAndReuse: passed under network denial; prepared model inference cancelled before completion, cancellation returned within the 5-second bound, same model then recognized nonempty speech
checks.phraseJoining: three focused English/Chinese boundary and source-provenance regressions passed
checks.quietInputAndPersistence: three focused quiet/silent input and timed-edit persistence regressions passed

limits: The one previously reviewed strict date-surface flag remains; it is not silently counted as a passing gate.
The original combined WER and 1.5 GiB RSS gates remain failed. The 17-case partial rerun intentionally lacks full tag coverage; its generic combined decision also remains failed.
Amplitude-gate recovery and source-range validity do not establish independent phonetic alignment accuracy.
Installed App four-entry interaction acceptance, release holdout and minimum-device eligibility are not established by these tuning runs.
Codex Security tooling was unavailable; local boundary review is not a service scan.
